articles.title_en: The burdens of participation: A mixed-methods study of the effects of a nutrition-sensitive agriculture program on women’s time use in Malawi
articles.title_cn: 参与的负担：一项关于营养敏感型农业项目对马拉维妇女时间使用影响的混合方法研究
articles.abstract_en: Development programs often rely on women’s participation. However, there is little evidence of whether development programs that engage women’s unpaid labor – particularly in care work – add to their time burdens. We tested this hypothesis on a nutrition-sensitive agriculture program delivered through community-based preschools in Malawi. The mixed-methods study was conducted over one year using data from 1,168 female caregivers from a cluster-randomized control trial. A longitudinal binomial logistic regression model was used to estimate the proportion of time spent caregiving in a 24-hour period (expressed as minutes) at baseline and then separately for each treatment group at 6-months and 1-year post-randomization. In addition, two rounds of 38 qualitative in-depth interviews (n = 76) were conducted with women, men and adolescent girls to explore their perceptions of program activities, time use and gender attitudes. We found that the program quantitatively increased daily caregiving time for participating women by approximately 30 min. However, this effect occurred only during the lean season when preschool scale-up investments increased. Qualitatively, program-related tasks were not considered burdensome. Moreover, participants saw contributions as important investments in their children’s development. These findings add to limited evidence of the impacts of nutrition-sensitive agricultural programs and early childhood interventions on women’s time use. Measuring women’s participation through mixed-method evaluations can aid interpretation to avoid harm and to better understand the tradeoffs of women’s time.
articles.abstract_cn: 发展项目往往依赖妇女的参与。然而，关于发展项目是否增加了妇女的时间负担，尤其是涉及无偿劳动（特别是照护工作）的项目，证据有限。我们在马拉维通过社区学前班实施的一项营养敏感型农业项目中检验了这一假设。这项混合方法研究历时一年，使用了来自一项整群随机对照试验的1,168名女性照护者的数据。采用纵向二项逻辑回归模型，估计基线时24小时内用于照护的时间比例（以分钟表示），并在随机化后6个月和1年时分别对每个治疗组进行估计。此外，进行了两轮共38次定性深度访谈（n = 76），对象为女性、男性和青春期女孩，以探讨他们对项目活动、时间使用和性别态度的看法。我们发现，该项目在数量上使参与女性的每日照护时间增加了约30分钟。然而，这种效应仅发生在淡季，当时学前班扩大规模的投资有所增加。定性上，项目相关任务并不被视为负担。此外，参与者认为这些贡献是对子女发展的重要投资。这些发现补充了关于营养敏感型农业项目和儿童早期干预对妇女时间使用影响的有限证据。通过混合方法评估来衡量妇女的参与，有助于解释结果，避免伤害，并更好地理解妇女时间的权衡。

articles.title_en: Migration in Libya: A spatial network analysis
articles.title_cn: 利比亚的移民：空间网络分析
articles.abstract_en: Libya is the African country with the highest proportion of migrants and it is the major migration gateway to Europe. Since the fall of Gaddafi’s regime in 2011, Libya has been experiencing a prolonged period of instability and conflict which has also affected migration flows. This paper provides the first analytical study of the networks of irregular migrants toward, within, and from Libya since the beginning of the Second Civil War in 2014. We use longitudinal-geolocalised data on migrants’ movements and combine tools taken from spatial statistics and network analysis to reconstruct the network of migrants’ international movements towards and from Libya, and the network of migrants’ internal movements within Libya. Employing the information obtained from these networks, we map the different migrant routes within the country, we provide evidence that migrants sort into routes according to their nationality, and we show how these routes have evolved over time. Moreover, using a Separable Temporal Exponential Random Graph (STERG) model, we document that migrants are more likely to move towards areas with higher economic opportunities, lower level of conflict intensity, more same country-of-origin migrants, and connecting to multiple routes. Our analysis shows how to combine migration data with insights from spatial statistics and network analysis in order to reconstruct migrants’ movements.
articles.abstract_cn: 利比亚是非洲移民比例最高的国家，也是通往欧洲的主要移民门户。自2011年卡扎菲政权倒台以来，利比亚经历了长期的不稳定和冲突，这也影响了移民流动。本文提供了自2014年第二次内战开始以来，针对进入、穿越和离开利比亚的非正规移民网络的首次分析研究。我们使用移民流动的纵向地理定位数据，并结合空间统计和网络分析的工具，重建了移民往返利比亚的国际流动网络以及利比亚境内的内部流动网络。利用从这些网络中获得的信息，我们绘制了该国境内不同的移民路线，提供了移民根据国籍选择路线的证据，并展示了这些路线如何随时间演变。此外，使用可分离时间指数随机图（STERG）模型，我们记录了移民更可能流向经济机会更高、冲突强度更低、同国籍移民更多以及连接多条路线的地区。我们的分析展示了如何将移民数据与空间统计和网络分析的见解相结合，以重建移民的流动。

articles.title_en: Reforming justice under a security crisis: The case of the criminal justice reform in Mexico
articles.title_cn: 安全危机下的司法改革：墨西哥刑事司法改革案例
articles.abstract_en: This paper assesses how the adoption of a common-law style model affects crime rates, pretrial detention, and judicial efficiency measures. We do this in the context of Mexico, where a judicial reform was fully implemented by 2016, both on the state and federal levels. Using a generalized synthetic control group approach (Xu, 2017) and municipality-level administrative data for the years 1997–2012, we find that the reform increased the homicide rate and was accompanied by a reduction in the use of pretrial detention for property crimes in the early implementer municipalities. The increase in the homicide rate was, nonetheless, much greater in the municipalities with established organized crime presence, where we also observed a greater reduction in the capacity to effectively prosecute homicides. Our results describe the difficulties in implementing this kind of reform in developing countries experiencing security crises.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文评估了采用普通法模式对犯罪率、审前拘留和司法效率指标的影响。我们在墨西哥的背景下进行此项研究，该国在2016年前已在州和联邦层面全面实施了司法改革。使用广义合成控制组方法（Xu, 2017）和1997-2012年市政层面的行政数据，我们发现改革提高了凶杀率，并在早期实施改革的市中伴随财产犯罪审前拘留使用的减少。然而，在既有有组织犯罪存在的市中，凶杀率的增加幅度更大，同时我们也观察到有效起诉凶杀案件的能力下降更为显著。我们的结果描述了在经历安全危机的发展中国家实施此类改革的困难。

articles.title_en: Price, credit or ambiguity? Increasing small-scale irrigation in Ethiopia
articles.title_cn: 价格、信贷还是模糊性？扩大埃塞俄比亚小规模灌溉
articles.abstract_en: Governments in countries in Sub-Saharan Africa (SSA) are keen to expand irrigation to improve food security and are placing particular emphasis on adoption and use of smallholder private groundwater irrigation. Yet private irrigation is a multi-stage technology, the adoption of which is affected by fiscal support and extension services offered on different investment stages but also by uncertainties around actions that need to be undertaken in these stages. Groundwater-based irrigation in Ethiopia presents a case where policy has focused on fiscally easing the purchase of pumps while considerable ambiguity (unquantifiable uncertainty) exists around the outcomes of drilling boreholes (reaching water). In this paper, we examine farmers’ willingness to adopt smallholder private irrigation packages in response to lower pump prices following tax breaks, loan availability, and reduction in ambiguities related to borehole drilling, using a discrete choice experiment (DCE) in two districts of Ethiopia. The results indicate that the provision of loans and reduction in ambiguities related to well drilling have the greatest effect on the probability of farmers adopting irrigation packages. Lowering pump prices has the smallest effect. Pump-type has a small effect, with energized pumps preferred over manual ones. In exploring heterogeneity in preferences, we find that farmers without irrigated plots and those with greater market access have a greater preference for the provision of loans, while those with greater market access also have greater preferences for reductions in well drilling ambiguities. The results of this choice experiment suggest that reducing ambiguities around well drilling (initial investments) is an essential and cost-effective step toward expanding groundwater-based irrigation in Ethiopia.
articles.abstract_cn: 撒哈拉以南非洲（SSA）国家的政府热衷于扩大灌溉以改善粮食安全，并特别强调小农私人地下水灌溉的采用和使用。然而，私人灌溉是一项多阶段技术，其采用受到不同投资阶段提供的财政支持和推广服务的影响，也受到这些阶段所需采取行动的不确定性的影响。埃塞俄比亚基于地下水的灌溉提供了一个案例，政策侧重于通过财政手段减轻购买水泵的负担，而钻井（达到水源）的结果存在相当大的模糊性（不可量化的不确定性）。在本文中，我们使用离散选择实验（DCE）在埃塞俄比亚的两个地区，考察了农民在税收减免、贷款可得性以及钻井相关模糊性减少的情况下，对采用小农私人灌溉方案的意愿。结果表明，提供贷款和减少与钻井相关的模糊性对农民采用灌溉方案的概率影响最大。降低水泵价格的影响最小。水泵类型影响较小，电动泵优于手动泵。在探索偏好异质性时，我们发现没有灌溉地块的农民和市场化程度较高的农民对提供贷款有更大的偏好，而市场化程度较高的农民对减少钻井模糊性也有更大的偏好。该选择实验的结果表明，减少钻井（初始投资）的模糊性是扩大埃塞俄比亚基于地下水灌溉的重要且具有成本效益的步骤。

articles.title_en: Gray skies and blue moms: The effect of air pollution on parental life satisfaction
articles.title_cn: 灰蒙蒙的天空与忧郁的妈妈：空气污染对父母生活满意度的影响
articles.abstract_en: We show that individuals report lower life satisfaction in response to worsening air quality if young children are present in the household. This observed impact is driven by the subpopulation of mothers, and it attenuates as children grow older. We conclude that mothers’ disproportionate responsibility for child-rearing and children’s higher vulnerability to air pollution are the likely channels that mediate the relationship. Our findings provide robust evidence on the importance of taking the presence of young children and parental family roles into account when calculating the monetary value of air quality using the life satisfaction approach.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们表明，如果家中有年幼的孩子，个人在空气质量恶化时报告的生活满意度较低。这一观察到的效应由母亲这一亚群体驱动，并随着孩子年龄增长而减弱。我们得出结论，母亲在育儿方面承担的不成比例的责任以及儿童对空气污染的更高脆弱性，是调节这一关系的可能渠道。我们的发现为在采用生活满意度方法计算空气质量货币价值时，考虑年幼孩子的存在和父母家庭角色的重要性提供了有力证据。

articles.title_en: Does environmental regulation increase domestic value-added in exports? An empirical study of cleaner production standards in China
articles.title_cn: 环境规制是否提高了出口的国内附加值？——基于中国清洁生产标准的实证研究
articles.abstract_en: The effectiveness of environmental regulations and foreign trade competitiveness are important concerns for developing countries that face serious environmental degradation and boost economies by participating in the global market. Taking the cleaner production standards in China as a case study, this paper investigates the relationship between the environmental regulations and export upgrading from the perspective of the domestic value-added rate (DVAR) of exports. We find that cleaner production standards increase Chinese enterprises’ DVAR, and the impact varies with firms’, industrial and regional heterogeneities. Mechanism analysis shows that the markup percentage of cost and the total factor productivity enhance the positive effect of cleaner production regulations on enterprises’ DVAR. Moreover, we also find that 43.94% of the promotion of Chinese enterprises’ DVAR is contributed by the resource reallocation effect brought by the cleaner production standards. This study provides empirical evidence that environmental regulations coordinate the development of the ecological environment and the upgrading of Chinese exports, which is also of enlightening significance to other developing countries in the transition to a high-quality development path.
articles.abstract_cn: 环境规制的有效性和外贸竞争力是面临严重环境退化并通过参与全球市场促进经济的发展中国家的重要关切。以中国清洁生产标准为例，本文从出口国内附加值率（DVAR）的角度研究了环境规制与出口升级之间的关系。我们发现清洁生产标准提高了中国企业的DVAR，且该影响因企业、行业和地区的异质性而有所不同。机制分析表明，成本加成率和全要素生产率增强了清洁生产规制对企业DVAR的正向效应。此外，我们还发现中国企业DVAR提升的43.94%归因于清洁生产标准带来的资源再配置效应。本研究提供了环境规制协调生态环境发展与出口升级的经验证据，这对其他向高质量发展路径转型的发展中国家也具有启示意义。

articles.title_en: Income inequality in Africa, 1990–2019: Measurement, patterns, determinants
articles.title_cn: 非洲收入不平等，1990-2019：测度、模式与决定因素
articles.abstract_en: This article estimates the evolution of income inequality in Africa from 1990 to 2019 by combining surveys, tax data, and national accounts. Inequality in Africa is very high: the regional top 10% income share nears 55%, on par with regions characterized by extreme inequality, such as Latin America and India. Most of continent-wide income inequality comes from the within-country component rather than from average income differences between countries. Inequality is highest in Southern Africa and lowest in Northern and Western Africa. It remained fairly stable from 1990 to 2019, with the exception of Southern Africa, where it increased significantly. Among historical determinants, this geographical pattern seems to reveal the long shadow of settler colonialism, at least in Sub-Saharan Africa; the spread of Islam stands out as another robust correlate. The poor quality of the raw data calls for great caution, in particular when analyzing country-level dynamics.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文通过结合调查、税收数据和国民账户，估计了非洲从1990年到2019年收入不平等的演变。非洲的不平等程度非常高：地区前10%%收入份额接近55%%，与拉丁美洲和印度等以极端不平等为特征的地区相当。非洲大陆整体收入不平等主要来自国家内部组成部分，而非国家间平均收入差异。南部非洲的不平等程度最高，北部和西部非洲最低。从1990年到2019年，不平等程度保持相对稳定，但南部非洲除外，其不平等程度显著上升。在历史决定因素中，这种地理模式似乎揭示了定居者殖民主义的长期影响，至少在撒哈拉以南非洲如此；伊斯兰教的传播是另一个稳健的相关因素。原始数据质量较差，需要高度谨慎，尤其是在分析国家层面动态时。
